svg.title: Lanka — Ember Rite level blueprint
svg.desc: Cross the high Wind Arch for a quick site switch, or keep the vessel under cover along the longer salt arcade. North is up. Two scaled site details and a floor elevation section accompany the plan.
svg.text: The windward citadel and Ashoka Garden
Cross the high Wind Arch for a quick site switch, or keep the vessel under cover
Profile connects room centres. Vertical scale exaggerated. Landings are flat in the 3D model.
